pictures.name: GL1-Wedding-Feast
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. An ancient Babylonian Jewish courtyard at night, hung with lanterns and rich woven carpets: a wedding feast with low tables of fruit, bread and wine. In the middle, Mar son of Ravina, a Babylonian Jewish sage in his fifties with a short gray beard, an ivory robe and an indigo head wrap stands proudly beside his young son, the bridegroom, in a white robe. Guests in fine robes and head wraps, warm golden light, deep blue night sky.

pictures.name: GL4-The-Cup-Breaks
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. The jeweled glass cup bursting into glittering shards as it hits the stone floor of the courtyard, frozen in mid-moment, sparkling in lantern light. Mar son of Ravina, a Babylonian Jewish sage in his fifties with a short gray beard, an ivory robe and an indigo head wrap stands calmly above it, hand still open. Guests behind him startled into stillness. No one hurt, the shards fall safely on the floor.
